clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says almost all corn grown in America and Canada today comes from Monsanto seed, genetically modified or hybridized to do one job: put fat on cattle, fast.

His point: your body doesn't know the difference between you and a cow. The more of that corn you eat, the same thing happens to you that happens to the cattle it was bred for.

It isn't just the corn on the cob. Kevin's list of hidden names: corn syrup solids, high fructose corn syrup, corn starch, corn meal, corn flour.

Flip the bag before you trust the front of it.

#kevintrudeau #wbdaily #cornsyrup #readthelabel #realfood #foodtruth

Kevin Trudeau describes a simple comparison: one person drinks regular soda with real sugar, another drinks the diet version with aspartame instead.

His claim about what happens after 30 days - the diet soda drinker gains weight, even while eating fewer calories than the regular soda drinker. The opposite of the plan.

Kevin says Time magazine once put sucralose and aspartame on its cover and called them The New Crack, after researchers studied how addictive they are.

His read: they affect the same brain chemistry tied to feeling anxious, stressed and low.

Next time a label says no sugar, check what replaced it.

#kevintrudeau #wbdaily #artificialsweeteners #aspartame #readthelabel #foodtruth

Kevin Trudeau says look past the word 'healthy' on your green powder or protein shake.

His point: a lot of those products are mostly chlorophyll and plant fiber, which on their own taste exactly like what they are. So something gets added to cover that up.

Kevin's claim: that something is usually sucralose, the same artificial sweetener found in diet soda, sitting quietly on a label next to the words 'vitamins' and 'minerals.'

His line about the company making it - they know exactly what they put in the jar. They just need you to keep buying it.

Read the ingredient list, not the front of the label.

#kevintrudeau #wbdaily #readthelabel #sucralose #foodtruth #healthtruth

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says a pig will eat almost anything in its path, and whatever it eats becomes part of the meat on its bones.

His claim: pork takes about 48 hours to digest, longer than most meat, which he says puts extra strain on the body just processing it.

Kevin isn't a fanatic about this - he grew up Italian, eating pork chops and bacon at every meal. But after a few months of cutting it out, he says he noticed his energy come up and his head feel clearer.

His suggestion isn't to swear it off forever. It's to go a few months without it and actually notice how you feel.

#kevintrudeau #wbdaily #porkfacts #energylevels #foodtruth #healthtruth

Kevin Trudeau says more people get sick, and more people die, from bad shellfish than from any other food group.

His reasoning: shellfish, squid, octopus and catfish are natural filters. Whatever toxin is in the water around them gets stored in their flesh - and then on your plate.

Kevin grew up near Boston, where a red tide (poisonous algae) meant nobody could swim or eat anything pulled from that water that week. The same shellfish fine one month could make you sick the next.

His workaround: fish with scales and fins, like haddock, mackerel and cod, don't filter water the same way - which is why he still eats those.

#kevintrudeau #wbdaily #shellfish #foodtruth #readthelabel #healthtruth

Kevin Trudeau tells a story about his friend Mike Siegel, a 10-time world pool champion, who could not stop ordering mussels.

City after city, restaurant after restaurant, Mike ordered mussels off the menu. And city after city, he woke up sick the next day.

Kevin pointed out the pattern. Mike tested it himself: order mussels, get sick. Skip them, feel fine. Order them again, get sick again.

Mike's answer, every time? He kept ordering them anyway, because he loved the taste, fully knowing what tomorrow would bring.

Kevin's lesson: knowing what a food does to you and still reaching for it is a choice. Just make it with your eyes open.

#kevintrudeau #wbdaily #shellfish #foodtruth #funnystory #healthtruth
